name: East Adriatic Current
scope: OSW offshore eastern-Adriatic reference corridor under the Otranto-to-Istria surface-circulation convention. Gates are editorial neighborhoods, not observed origins or termination. Excludes western return flow, sub-basin recirculation loops and unverified island-channel branches. The possible Dalmatian-name overlap is unresolved and its extent is not transferred. The published 800 km basin length is not used as current length; this estimate comes from the declared OSW vertices.
layer: General surface-circulation geography; no velocity-defined current core or uniform intermediate/full-depth layer diagnosed.
time_convention: Undated editorial corridor supported by published general circulation descriptions. Not the 2002-2003 local mooring trajectory, annual mean observed axis or seasonal path.
source_locator: Sciascia et al. (2018), Section 2.1 and Figure 1 caption: northwestward eastern Balkan coast circulation, separate western return and three sub-basin gyres. Endpoint convention from Urbini et al. (2020), Study Area, circulation paragraph.
source_citation: Sciascia et al. (2018), Linking sardine recruitment in coastal areas to ocean currents using surface drifters and HF radar: a case study in the Gulf of Manfredonia, Adriatic Sea, Ocean Science 14, 1461-1482, doi:10.5194/os-14-1461-2018.

supporting_sources.citation: Urbini et al. (2020), Temporal and Spatial Variability of the CO2 System in a Riverine Influenced Area of the Mediterranean Sea, the Northern Adriatic, doi:10.3389/fmars.2020.00679.
supporting_sources.locator: Study Area, general circulation paragraph: eastern-side northward flow from Otranto toward Istrian Peninsula, citing Poulain (2001).
supporting_sources.role: Regional endpoint convention; not a measured continuous current axis or named termination.

coordinate_selection: OSW selects coarse offshore vertices progressing northwest from eastern Otranto through Albanian/Dalmatian coastal neighborhoods to an offshore Istrian approach. Longitude alternatives change offshore detour placement; they are not current edges or observed width. No source arrows or drifter tracks digitized. Coarse coast clearance does not resolve the many islands or channels.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW farther-offshore corridor; excludes island-channel detail and is not a seasonal displacement.
OSW closer coastal corridor under the same neighborhood gates; not an observed current core or shoreward edge.

scenario_rule: Three declared offshore corridors crossed with uniform longitude shifts -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees and independent endpoint latitude shifts -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 81 editorial scenarios; not seasonal variability, current width or confidence bounds.
figure_source_label: Sciascia et al. (2018), sec. 2.1; Urbini et al. (2020)
